items.job: Replace automatic transmission with rebuilt or used unit
items.note: CarComplaints owners report $2,300-$3,400 on average; a used unit costs less.

items.job: Replace ignition coil and spark plugs
items.note: Rear-bank coils on the V6 take longer. YourMechanic's average is about $385 per coil job.

items.t: Throttle body failure causes sudden power loss
items.job: Replace electronic throttle body

items.t: Power steering assist can suddenly cut out (recall)
items.job: Update steering software; replace parts if faulted
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Front lower control arm mount can rust through (recall)
items.job: Install front reinforcement cross-brace
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.job: Increase engine cover clearance or replace cruise/throttle cable parts
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: ABS module connector can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Replace reservoir cap and repair ABS connector
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Engine may stall when slowing down (recall)
items.job: Reprogram engine computer
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Liftgate latch may open in a crash (recall)
items.job: Replace liftgate latch rod, clip and spring
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.job: Replace steering wheel retention parts
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.job: Inspect and replace fuel line
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.job: Inspect and replace wiper module
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.job: Replace hybrid coolant pump
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Shift lever can come loose on replacement transmissions (recall)
items.job: Tighten shift lever bolt or replace lever
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer under the recall.

items.t: Rust in the rear wheel wells and body
items.job: Rust repair and patch panels for rear wheel arches
items.note: Severe rust-through may cost more than the vehicle is worth.

items.job: Replace fuel pump assembly
items.note: Owners report $100-$850.

items.job: Replace catalytic converter
items.note: Owners report about $1,000-$2,000; California-legal converters cost more.

items.job: Replace water pump and coolant
items.note: The internal V6 pump takes the most labor. Owners report about $800-$1,200.

items.job: Replace EGR DPFE sensor and hoses

items.t: Rough idle or stalling from the idle air control valve
items.job: Clean or replace idle air control valve
items.note: Owners report $50-$200.

items.t: Ignition switch or lock module causes no-crank
items.job: Replace ignition switch or lock cylinder
items.note: Owners report about $500.

items.t: Check engine light or trouble after refueling
items.job: EVAP smoke test and replace faulty part
Replace liftgate glass
items.note: Often covered by comprehensive insurance.
